field.name: feed_url
field.label: IRC ratings source
field.description: Address of the IRC club listing CSV. Needs the columns Boat Name, Sail No and TCC.

field.name: irc_boatdata_url
field.label: IRC boat data page
field.description: RORC's page of boat data for valid IRC certificates. Race management get a Boat data button next to each IRC boat on the Race entries page, which searches this page for the boat's certificate number. Leave empty to hide the button.

field.name: ytc_url
field.label: YTC ratings source
field.description: A Google Sheets link (shared so anyone with the link can view) or the address of a CSV file. Needs the columns Boat Name, Sail Number and YTC.

field.name: deadline_days
field.label: Default rating deadline (days before race)
field.description: Used for new races; each race can override it.

field.name: deadline_time
field.label: Deadline time of day (HH:MM)
field.description: Time on the deadline day, in the site time zone, after which rating changes no longer count. Applied when a race is saved.

fieldset.name: entries
fieldset.label: Entry form
fieldset.description: The Race entries page reads the RSForm! Pro entry form directly. Choose the form here, then link each race to its question when editing the race.

field.name: entry_form_id
field.label: Entry form ID
field.description: The ID of the entry form, shown in the ID column of Components - RSForm! Pro - Manage Forms. Leave empty to switch the Race entries page off.

field.name: entry_boat_field
field.label: Field name: Boat name
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_sail_field
field.label: Field name: Sail number
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_model_field
field.label: Field name: Boat type
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_class_field
field.label: Field name: Class
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_club_field
field.label: Field name: Club
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_declared_field
field.label: Field name: Declared rating
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_contact_field
field.label: Field name: Person in charge
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_email_field
field.label: Field name: E-mail
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_phone_field
field.label: Field name: Mobile number
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_category_field
field.label: Field name: Entry type
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

fieldset.name: fleetsheet
fieldset.label: YB fleetsheet
fieldset.description: Settings for the YB Tracking fleet information sheet that race management can download for each race from the Race entries page. Tracker ID is filled in for boats using their own tracker; otherwise the Serial and Tracker ID columns are left empty.

field.name: fleet_type
field.label: Type for every boat
field.description: One of the types on the sheet's Lookups tab.

field.name: fleet_bands
field.label: IRC class bands
field.description: One line per class: the column heading, an equals sign and the lowest TCC in that class. A boat goes into the highest class whose lowest TCC it reaches.
field.default: IRC Class 0=1.070 IRC Class 1=1.010 IRC Class 2=0

field.name: fleet_flags
field.label: Flag codes
field.description: One line per country: the country as it appears on the entry form, an equals sign and the flag code. Countries not listed are left blank on the sheet.

field.name: entry_country_field
field.label: Field name: Owner's country
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_photo_field
field.label: Field name: Yacht photograph
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form.

field.name: entry_owntracker_field
field.label: Field name: Using own tracker?
field.description: The name (not the caption) of the yes/no question on the entry form that asks whether the boat will use its own tracker.

field.name: entry_tracker_field
field.label: Field name: Own tracker serial number
field.description: The name (not the caption) of this field on the entry form. Its answer goes in the sheet's Tracker ID column, but only for boats that answered yes to the question above.

fieldset.name: api
fieldset.label: API
fieldset.description: A feed of the races and the boats entered for them, for another system such as Crewmanager. With the key that system can also choose a boat's secondary IRC certificate for a race, until the race's rating deadline. It includes each boat's person in charge with their e-mail and mobile number, so give the key only to systems that are allowed to hold those details. The addresses are in the admin guide.

field.name: api_key
field.label: API key
field.description: The other system must send this key with every request. Use a long random key of at least 20 characters. Leave empty to switch the API off; change it to cut off a system that has the old key.
